name: Infected Lands
desc:
The year is 2001. Two months have passed since the InFl virus spread across Kentucky. The region remains under quarantine, towns have fallen, and survivors now fight over what remains.
🧟 Infected Lands is an open-world zombie survival game where you can:

🔫 Fight infected and hostile survivors
🗺️ Explore towns, farms, checkpoints and the open world
📦 Loot buildings, vehicles and abandoned locations for supplies
🤝 Team up with others, join factions, or betray them

Infected Lands is actively developed with new content, fixes and balance changes.
